project.name: oil-change-pos
project.description: A point-of-sale system for an automotive oil-change and repair shop where salespeople enter every charge manually per customer and vehicle. Built with Laravel, Filament admin, and a Blade+Alpine POS front end. Note: this project has over 100 source files; consider scoping analysis to a subdirectory for faster results.

tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Start with the README to learn the oil-change POS rule: prices are typed by hand per customer and vehicle, never fixed by inventory.

tour.title: HTTP Entry Point
tour.description: Laravel boots through the public front controller and artisan CLI for the counter and admin experiences.

tour.title: Authorization Model
tour.description: Permissions and roles are enums bundled into Spatie roles — no code checks roles directly.

tour.title: Sales Domain
tour.description: Recording a sale is the core POS write path: actions, models, and line types that keep money arithmetic explicit.

tour.title: Counter UI (Blade + Alpine)
tour.description: The /pos counter is Blade + Alpine — capture customer/vehicle, add lines, type prices, and check out without a heavy SPA.

tour.title: Filament Admin
tour.description: Back-office inventory, staff, expenses, and module switchboard live in Filament under /admin.

tour.title: Plug-and-Play Modules
tour.description: Features register as Module subclasses and route files so Admin can disable navigation and return 404 without code edits.

tour.title: Money Support
tour.description: All arithmetic runs through shared Support helpers so totals stay consistent across POS and reports.
